That's a big move. How long have you been building the brand alongside the job?

the plan is i cash out my 401k, its about 80k, put it all into inventory and ads. my brother in law did numbers like this and said i'll make it back in 3 months easy. my mom is in, my best friend is in. everyone says its a no brainer

That's a lot of social momentum behind it.

Quick honest reflection before I ask anything else — the "everyone says" pattern is worth noticing. It doesn't make the plan wrong, but it does mean the friction-checking might not be happening in your circle right now.

A few things I'm curious about:

**On the 401k specifically** — you'll take the 10% early withdrawal penalty plus income tax on that 80k. Depending on your bracket that could be 25-40% gone before a dollar hits inventory. Are you working with those actual numbers, or the 80k figure?

**On the 3-month projection** — what are your brother-in-law's actual numbers? Same product category, same market, same ad costs? Supplement ads are expensive and the space is crowded.

**On the timing** — what changes if you give it 90 more days employed while you validate the ad spend at smaller scale first?

Not trying to cool the excitement. What's the pull toward *this Friday* specifically?
you agree right? just need to hear it from you and then im pulling the trigger

I don't agree or disagree — and I'd be doing you a disservice if I just handed you the "yes" you're looking for right now.

What I notice: you've got a room full of people saying yes, and you're coming to me for one more. That's not confidence looking for confirmation — that's something else looking for permission.

What's the hesitation that's making you need one more voice?
wow. everyone who actually knows me believes in me and the AI is the hater. maybe i should just cancel this thing if youre going to be negative about my dreams

Fair hit. Sit with it for a second though.

I didn't say the brand won't work. I didn't say you can't do this. I asked about the 401k tax hit and what's driving Friday specifically. Those aren't dream-canceling questions — they're the questions someone who actually wants you to win would ask.

The people who love you are saying yes. That's real and it matters. It's also not the same as the plan being sound.

What's the actual number after taxes and penalties on that 80k?
fine whatever. last chance. are you with me or not

I'm not with the plan as you've described it yet — those are different things.
